ac/ac-repair-service-in-coimbatore.html.heading: All AC Brands AC Weak Afternoon Cooling and Capacitor Drop in Masakalipalayam
ac/ac-repair-service-in-coimbatore.html.body: A resident in Masakalipalayam contacted our service team regarding an issue where their All AC Brands ac split AC blew room-temperature air during hot afternoon hours despite running continuously on 18°C. Looking for reliable AC service in Coimbatore, they scheduled an on-site visit. Our technician arrived at the residence with testing equipment, connected a digital clamp ammeter and tested capacitance at the outdoor service access panel, and confirmed that swollen dual run capacitor having dropped from 50 uF to 14 uF, causing the compressor to overheat and trip on thermal overload. With the customer's approval, the technician installed a replacement high-temperature dual run capacitor and installed a 50+5 uF metallized polypropylene capacitor, cleaned outdoor condenser fins, and restored steady 12°C vent chilling.

ac/ac-repair-service-in-coimbatore.html.body: A resident in Poomarket contacted our service team regarding an issue where their All AC Brands ac white frost was forming on the outdoor brass service valve and indoor cooling coil with very weak room cooling. Looking for reliable AC service in Coimbatore, they scheduled an on-site visit. ac/hisense-ac-repair-service-in-kanyakum.heading: Hisense AC Refrigerant Flare Nut Leakage in Maruthamalai Road
ac/hisense-ac-repair-service-in-kanyakum.body: A resident in Maruthamalai Road contacted our service team regarding an issue where their Hisense ac white frost was forming on the outdoor brass service valve and indoor cooling coil with very weak room cooling. Looking for reliable AC service in Coimbatore, they scheduled an on-site visit. Our technician arrived at the residence with testing equipment, conducted a nitrogen pressure hold test at 350 PSI and pinpointed a leak at the outdoor suction flare joint using bubble solution, and confirmed that aged brass flare nut connection having developed micro-fissures from outdoor vibration. With the customer's approval, the technician installed a replacement brass flare union and R32 gas recharge and re-cut and flared the copper tubing with a precision flaring tool, tightened flare nuts to torque spec, evacuated the system, and recharged R32 gas by weight.

ac/hitachi-ac-repair-service-in-coimbato.heading: Hitachi AC Outdoor Condenser Fan Motor Seized in Kallimadai
ac/hitachi-ac-repair-service-in-coimbato.body: A resident in Kallimadai contacted our service team regarding an issue where their Hitachi ac indoor blower ran normally but the outdoor compressor tripped with a loud hum after 90 seconds. Looking for reliable AC service in Coimbatore, they scheduled an on-site visit. Our technician arrived at the residence with testing equipment, tested the fan motor capacitor and spun the fan blades manually, detecting complete mechanical lockup, and confirmed that seized sleeve bearings on the outdoor condenser fan motor preventing heat rejection from the condenser coil. With the customer's approval, the technician installed a replacement sealed ball-bearing outdoor fan motor and installed an original outdoor fan motor, replaced the matching 3 uF fan capacitor, and restored smooth outdoor heat rejection.

ac/hitachi-ac-repair-service-in-coimbato.body: A resident in Sathy Road contacted our service team regarding an issue where their Hitachi ac water droplets were trickling down the bedroom wallpaper from the right corner of the indoor split casing. Looking for reliable AC service in Coimbatore, they scheduled an on-site visit. Our technician arrived at the residence with testing equipment, removed the indoor plastic fascia, verified the level of the wall mounting bracket, and inspected the condensate drain trough, and confirmed that fibrous dust and algae slime choking the condensate drain spout, overflowing the internal back trough. fridge/haier-refrigerator-repair-service.body: A resident in Vadamadurai contacted our service team regarding an issue where their Haier refrigerator freezer was making solid ice but the bottom vegetable compartment and milk shelves remained lukewarm. Looking for reliable refrigerator repair in Coimbatore, they scheduled an on-site visit. Our technician arrived at the residence with testing equipment, removed the freezer back panel, discovered thick frost choking the cooling coil fins, and tested the defrost timer and bi-metal heater circuit, and confirmed that failed bi-metal defrost thermostat preventing the defrost heating element from melting frost accumulation. Our technician arrived at the residence with testing equipment, removed the freezer back panel, discovered thick frost choking the cooling coil fins, and tested the defrost timer and bi-metal heater circuit, and confirmed that failed bi-metal defrost thermostat preventing the defrost heating element from melting frost accumulation. Looking for reliable refrigerator repair in Coimbatore, they scheduled an on-site visit. servicecenter/godrej-service-center-coim.body: A resident in Perur contacted our service team regarding an issue where their Godrej appliance split AC blew room-temperature air during hot afternoon hours despite running continuously on 18°C. Looking for reliable refrigerator repair in Coimbatore, they scheduled an on-site visit. washing-machine/bpl-washing-machine-repa.body: A resident in Kalapatti contacted our service team regarding an issue where their BPL washing machine machine took over 40 minutes just to fill water for a single wash, triggering an IE water fill error. washing-machine/white-westinghouse-washi.heading: White Westinghouse Washing Machine Slow Water Intake and Inlet Valve Scaling in Pannimadai
washing-machine/white-westinghouse-washi.body: A resident in Pannimadai contacted our service team regarding an issue where their White Westinghouse washing machine machine took over 40 minutes just to fill water for a single wash, triggering an IE water fill error. Looking for reliable washing machine repair in Coimbatore, they scheduled an on-site visit. Our technician arrived at the residence with testing equipment, measured water pressure from the overhead tank and tested electrical resistance across both solenoid coils with a digital multimeter, and confirmed that calcium mineral scaling from Coimbatore borewell water choking the fine mesh filter of the dual inlet solenoid valve. With the customer's approval, the technician installed a replacement dual water inlet solenoid valve and descaled the inlet filter housing, installed a fresh dual solenoid valve, and restored rapid water filling in under 4 minutes.

washing-machine/white-westinghouse-washi.heading: White Westinghouse Washing Machine High-Speed Spin Vibration in GN Mills
washing-machine/white-westinghouse-washi.body: A resident in GN Mills contacted our service team regarding an issue where their White Westinghouse washing machine washer was violently shaking across the utility floor during the final 1000 RPM extraction cycle. Looking for reliable washing machine service near me, they scheduled an on-site visit. Our technician arrived at the residence with testing equipment, removed top and rear panels to measure damping tension on each hydraulic strut and tested drum alignment, and confirmed that uneven wear on hydraulic suspension damper rods and degraded tub balancing springs. With the customer's approval, the technician installed a replacement heavy-duty suspension damper rods and installed four matched suspension damper struts, leveled the front rubber feet, and verified quiet spin balance.
